notes.title: Demo 0.5.0.0
notes.content:
[p][b]Black Ox Demo is Live — Try It Now![/b][/p][p]The [i]Black Ox[/i] demo is here!
You can play up to [b]50 matches[/b] in this version — and when a new update drops, your progress will reset.[/p][p]This is still a work in progress, so you may encounter bugs or rough edges. We’d love your help finding them — every report makes the game better.[/p][p][b]How to help:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play the demo and explore all the mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Report any bugs, glitches, or balance issues you find.[/p][/*][*][p]Share your thoughts on what you enjoy and what could improve.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback will directly shape the future of [i]Black Ox[/i].
[b]Follow[/b] and [b]Wishlist[/b] now to stay updated on upcoming updates and the full release.[/p]
